scripts.test:package: npm run android && playwright test -c playwright.package.config.js
scripts.android: npm run www && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:install: npm run android && cd android && gradlew installDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android && cd android && gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android && cd android && gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.android:open: npm run android && npx cap open android
